race.comment: EVIL LOVER (1) came from well back on the bend and hit the line strongly to score over 1125m at Grafton last time out. Will be tough to hold out again if she holds that sort of form. DEVIOUS MIND (8) doesn't win out of turn but ran a strong race last time out at Grafton, finishing fourth after being in the firing line on the turn. Has the ability to take care of this field. RAINBOW LASS (5) never looked likely first-up but warmed nicely late after turning a mile off them, closing off well into midfield. Will get back again from the draw but can launch late if the pace is fDARLING TAKE CARE (12) settled well back last time out then found the line strongly to finish 5 lengths away in fourth over 1100m at Gatton. Can feature in the finish. MUM KNOWS (11) was better last start and is open to further improvement third-up. Keeping safe.
